description: Build e2e_scenarios.py covering three canonical flows: (1) new MCP ingestion -> signal scoring -> verdict -> attestation -> UI visible, (2) submission portal -> approval workflow -> verdict update, (3) threat intel overlay -> risk rank change. Script must demonstrate end-to-end pipeline without actual network calls or DB writes. Pure test harness that validates signal flow logic. Refer to spec section 1 core loop and section 4 data contracts for expected state transitions.
